about: Tip of the Day (HS-10): one tip at a time in a window of its own, the ones this person has not seen first. Fields: id (stable, never reused: it is how a tip is remembered as seen), title, text; optional: action, the ActionCatalog id whose menu path the text spells out (TipsCheck holds the text to it); target, a component name to spotlight with Show Me, as a tour step does, and reveal, a catalog id run first to bring it on screen; tour, a tour id offered with Take the Tour; newUser, true for the tips a first-time user should see first. See docs/tips-and-tooltips.md.

tips.title: The image canvas
tips.text: Your layers are drawn on the canvas. Scroll to zoom, drag to rotate or pan (the Rotate and Pan buttons on the toolbar choose which), and double-click to reset the view.

tips.title: Add data
tips.text: New Layer adds data for the time range and time step beside it. Pick a format at the top of its menu: JPEG 2000 for fast Helioviewer images, FITS (VSO) for calibrated files, or FITS (native) for a mission's own archive.

tips.title: Drop files in
tips.text: Drop FITS or JPEG 2000 files anywhere on the window to load them as image layers; drop a .jhv file to open that session.

tips.title: Nothing loaded yet?
tips.text: Help > Open Demo Scene opens a new session with a bundled SDO/AIA 171 image and RHEF on; nothing to download.

tips.title: Colour and brightness
tips.text: Select a layer in the list to see its options. Under Display, Color picks the color table; under Intensity, the two Levels handles set the brightness window.

tips.title: Play the movie
tips.text: Play runs the movie and the arrows beside it step one frame at a time. J, K and L play backward, stop and play forward from anywhere in the window.

tips.title: Find any control
tips.text: Help > Search Controls... finds any command or control by name and shows you where it is: Cmd-K on a Mac, Ctrl-K elsewhere.

tips.title: Ask a control
tips.text: Rest the pointer on any button, box or slider for a moment and a tooltip says what it does.

tips.title: Take the tour
tips.text: Help > Take the Tour steps through the main controls, one at a time.

tips.title: More tours
tips.text: Help > Tours has short guided tours: loading data, making a movie, views and projections, and sharing your work.

tips.title: Your own starting scene
tips.text: File > Set Current Session as Default opens this scene at every start, ahead of the last session.

tips.title: Present
tips.text: View > Present shows the output only, full screen. Esc leaves.

tips.title: Where did this come from?
tips.text: File > Copy Provenance puts the program, its build and each layer's data source on the clipboard.

tips.title: Undo
tips.text: Edit > Undo takes back the last change to the scene.

tips.title: Reading an RHEF image
tips.text: RHEF, in a layer's Filter list, is a visualization, not a calibrated radiance. Measure on the original data, with the filter set to None.

tips.title: Fewer frames, faster
tips.text: Time step, beside New Layer, sets the time between frames for the next layer; tick Frame count to set how many frames instead. The line under it estimates the video length before anything downloads.

tips.title: Change a layer's data
tips.text: Double-click a layer's name in the layer list to change its dataset.

tips.title: The newest PUNCH day
tips.text: Layers > PUNCH Latest opens the newest day of PUNCH clear average mosaics (CAM) in Helioradial with RHEF.

tips.title: Before and after
tips.text: Layers > Duplicate Layer adds a copy of the selected image layer. Compare, on the toolbar, then blinks between two layers or swipes a divider across the view.

tips.title: Side by side
tips.text: Multiview, on the toolbar, puts each shown image layer in a view of its own, side by side.

tips.title: Change the projection
tips.text: Projection, on the toolbar, opens a palette that changes how the Sun is mapped onto the screen: Orthographic, HPC, Helioradial or Latitudinal.

tips.title: Timelines
tips.text: The Timelines pane plots time series and events against the movie time. Click an empty part of the plot to move the movie to that time.

tips.title: Record a movie
tips.text: The red dot records the view as a movie; click it again to stop. Files go to the Exports folder inside the HFStudio folder in your home folder.

tips.title: A movie in one click
tips.text: File > Quick Share records one loop as a movie that plays anywhere, then shows it in the file manager; your recording settings are not changed.

tips.title: Trim the movie
tips.text: Movie > Trim Start Here (I) and Trim End Here (O) set the movie's in and out points at the current frame; Movie > Reset Trim clears them.

tips.title: Copy the picture
tips.text: Edit > Copy Frame puts the canvas picture on the clipboard, as an 8-bit screenshot.

tips.title: Send a scene to someone
tips.text: File > Share Scene... saves the scene for someone else, with your home folder written as ~ and any local files outside the cache listed first.

tips.title: Take it to another computer
tips.text: File > Export Session with Data... saves the session plus a .data.zip of its local files, to open on another computer.

tips.title: On to Python
tips.text: Layers > Send to Python writes the active layer's FITS files as double-precision science FITS, plus a manifest and a sunpy snippet.

tips.title: HDR
tips.text: HDR, on the toolbar, sets how the whole view is mapped into the display's extended range: headroom, mapping, knee, in-range share and clipped pixels.

tips.title: Tell the developer
tips.text: Help > Send Feedback... sends a problem, a request or a question to the developer; no account needed.

tips.title: Fewer tips
tips.text: Snooze, in this window, stops tips at startup for a day, a week or a month, and Show a tip at startup turns them off. Neither touches the Welcome window.
